location_note: Lower western slope of a hill east of Nahal Qidron by es-Sawahra (Khurbet Jubb er Rum of the SWP map); map ref. 22470/62860 (NIG).
notes: 2003 salvage excavation of a Byzantine monastery (6th c. CE, continuing into the Early Islamic period): courtyards, church, 'bakery', rooms, cistern, roof-water collection and drains, and a subterranean burial complex of five tombs with rock-hewn graves, built sarcophagi and arcosolia. A second cistern east of the excavation was only 'discerned'; not coded. Small plastered industrial installations (L1077, L1110, Area 20) not coded. The large flint wall recorded by the Jerusalem Survey is not eligible.
